[SWS_SM_00211] ResetMachine notification
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00004
⌈
State Management
shall provide the service interface
UpdateRequest
to
Update
and Configuration Management
with the field
ResetMachineNotifier
thus it
can trace the status from the
ResetMachine
call during and after it is performed.
⌋
